title: Closeness from high tester acceptance
statement: Let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$, let $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^{n^2}\to\mathbb F_2$. If the linearized-system character tester for $L$ accepts $f$ with probability at least $1-\varepsilon/2$, then there is a vector $a\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$ satisfying every equation of $L$ such that the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to the linear function $x\mapsto a\cdot x$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a homogeneous quadratic system in dimension $n$
$f$ maps the binary cube of dimension $n^2$ to $\mathbb F_2$
tester acceptance probability is at least $1-\varepsilon/2$
